info.name: Apache Log4j2 Remote Code Execution
info.description: Apache Log4j2 JNDI remote code execution via crafted input leading to code injection.

info.name: Reflected Cross-Site Scripting
info.description: User input is reflected without encoding, enabling reflected cross-site scripting (XSS).

info.name: Open Redirect
info.description: The next parameter allows an unvalidated redirect to an attacker-controlled URL (open redirect).

info.name: Potential SSRF in webhook parameter
info.description: The webhook URL parameter fetches arbitrary internal hosts, a server-side request forgery (SSRF).

info.name: Exposed .git/config
info.description: The .git directory is exposed, leaking source and possibly credentials (information disclosure).
